entries.title: Luto

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because it has the complete game with PC capture/settings flexibility, while no sourced platform-exclusive content or enhanced edition was identified elsewhere.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Luto on Steam and play the Windows PC build. Use PS5 or Xbox Series X|S only for platform preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original release; no remake/remaster distinction applies.
